title: One-Sided Candidate-Only Pareto Confirmation — Software and Reproducibility Core
description: Version 1.2.0 of the software and reproducibility core supporting one-sided candidate-only confirmation of strict positive-witness archive separation for one externally selected candidate relative to a fixed finite archive in stochastic simulation. The release provides independent and common-scenario procedures, coordinate, Hotelling and hybrid evidence, count-indexed spending, replayable certificate artefacts, deterministic synthetic fixtures, tests and machine-readable applicability boundaries. The release also includes source-based figure generation using PlantUML semantic sources, Python quantitative scripts and normalised OOXML exact-layout packages. It does not recover a full Pareto front, does not certify equality-boundary ordinary nondominance and makes no claim of distribution-free, temporal-dependence or expected-time optimality. The unpublished manuscript, supplement and upstream observation rows are excluded.
notes: Manual controlled deposit. GitHub–Zenodo integration is not used for this version. Figure sources are included; the manuscript and supplement remain excluded.
